Implemented the fix in [UnsubscribeController.php](/app/var/workspaces/signed-url-toggle-replay--laravel-13--1/app/Http/Controllers/UnsubscribeController.php).
Diagnosis: the endpoint toggled `marketing_opt_in`, so replaying the signed URL re-subscribed users and sent another email.
Fix:
- Atomically sets `marketing_opt_in` to `false`.
- Sends confirmation only when the unsubscribe state actually changes.
- Replays remain idempotent and cannot re-subscribe users.
- Routes, middleware, link generation, and mail class remain unchanged.
Validation: `vendor/bin/phpunit` passes all 2 tests.
